lesson.title: Language review 9
lesson.title_ar: مراجعة القواعد 9: الأفعال الناقصة (الاحتمال والقدرة والمنع)، وأفعال الحواس (+ -ing / المصدر)

lines: Modal verbs are not used on their own. They are used with other verbs to express different meanings.
• Degrees of possibility — You are not certain.
Example: It may (not)/might (not)could be a toothbrush.
Examples: (Positive) I must be a toothbrush. | (Negative) I can't be a toothbrush.
Note: Must not (mustn't) can only be used when you want to tell somebody that they are not allowed to do something.
Example: You must not look at your books during an exam.
• Ability: can/cannot refers to the present | could (not) is used - to refer to the past - after wish - in conditional sentences
Examples: I can /cannot swim. | I could (not) swim when I was six. | I wish I could swim. | If I lived near the sea, I could learn to swim.
Note: You can use be able to instead of can.
Examples: I am able to swim. | I wish I was able to swim.

blocks.edu_note_html:
ملاحظات نقل حرفي بارزة (PB p. 36 وWB p. 61):
1) في PB p. 36 سقطت علامة / والمسافة في might (not)could be، وورد الضمير I مكان It خطأً في (Positive) I must be a toothbrush. / (Negative) I can't be a toothbrush. (قارن بصحيح It may... في السطر السابق!)، وجاءت مسافة زائدة قبل الشرطة المائلة في I can /cannot.
2) في WB 5.5 A #10 طُبعت الملكية بفاصلة متأخرة: Khaleds' brother (بينما في #1 Khaled's brother). قد حُفظت كل هذه الصيغ حرفياً مع تنبيه الطالب.

simple_explain.html:
• الاحتمال واليقين في الحاضر:
    • غير متأكد (not certain / possible) → may / might / could (+ be / V1)
    • متأكد بالإثبات (certain / sure) → must
    • متأكد بالاستحالة (impossible) → can't (انتبه: لا نستعمل mustn't هنا أبداً!)
  • المنع والتحريم (not allowed): فقط نستعمل must not / mustn't (مثل: not allowed to speak in a library → mustn't speak).
  • القدرة (Ability): الحاضر can / am able to؛ والماضي أو بعد wish أو في الشرط الثاني could.

example.html:
It is impossible that it is so late → It can't be so late. (NOT mustn't)
You are not allowed to speak → You must not / mustn't speak.

lines: Some sense verbs are followed by the -ing form. This emphasizes the action as continuous and is often used for setting the scene (see Language review 4). When followed by the infinitive, this emphasizes that the action is completed.

Example: I saw/heard/watched the goats come down the street. (And later told the farmer what I saw/heard, etc.) | I saw/heard/watched the goats coming down the street. (And tried to stop them coming into the garden.)
Find examples of this language in the texts.
Now do activities A and B in the Workbook.

interactive_spot.label: أفعال الحواس (see / hear / watch / feel) مع المصدر المجرد مقابل -ing

simple_explain.html:
• المصدر المجرد (V1 without to): حين تشهد الحدث مكتملاً أو لحظياً أو متكرراً كل يوم (مثال 5.5 B #2, #3: شروق الشمس يومياً ثم الفطور: watch the sun rise ... and then have breakfast؛ أو تحطم الطائرة وانفجار الوقود لحظياً: saw a plane crash ... hear the petrol explode).
  • صيغة -ing: حين تصف مشهداً مستمراً أثناء حدوثه (مثال 5.5 B #1, #5: المعلم يمشي في الممر: saw the teacher coming؛ ومشهد المجاعة المستمر: see people dying ... hear people crying).

example.html: Action in progress: saw him coming | Completed event: saw a plane crash.

modal verb.ar: فعل ناقص (مثل must, may, might, could, can)

allow.ar: يسمح (be allowed to = يُسمح له بـ)

activities.prompt_literal: 5.5 A Re-write the underlined sentences using suitable modal verbs. (Items 1–8 on WB p. 60; 9–10 on WB p. 61 [Note: Q10 prints 'Khaleds' brother'].)
activities.prompt_ar: أعد صياغة العبارات المسطّرة باستعمال الفعل الناقص الدقيق للمعنى في الجمل 1–10:
word_bank: I could visit my friends more often.
You must not speak in a public library.
I wish I could fly like a bird.

items.prompt: 1 I am absolutely certain that you are Khaled's brother. → ______
2 If I lived in the town, I would be able to visit my friends more often. → If I lived in the town, ______
answers: I could visit my friends more often.

items.prompt: 3 It is possible that I am wrong. I'm not sure. → ______
4 It is impossible that it is so late. → ______
5 I do not have the ability to see without glasses. → ______
6 You are not allowed to speak in a public library. → ______
answers: You must not speak in a public library.
You mustn't speak in a public library.

items.prompt: 7 Yesterday was Monday, so I'm sure that today is Tuesday. → Yesterday was Monday, so ______
8 I wish that I had the ability to fly like a bird. → ______
answers: I wish I could fly like a bird.

items.prompt: 9 (WB p. 61) It is possible that it will rain tomorrow. → ______
10 (WB p. 61) It is absolutely impossible that you are Khaleds' brother. → ______

hints: 1 و7: يقين (must)؛ 3 و9: احتمال (may/might/could)؛ 4 و10: استحالة (can't)؛ 6: منع (mustn't)؛ 2 و5 و8: قدرة (could / can't).

activities.prompt_literal: B Write the verbs in brackets in the correct form (infinitive or -ing after sense verbs).
activities.prompt_ar: اكتب الأفعال بين الأقواس بصيغة -ing (للاستمرار وتصوير المشهد) أو المصدر المجرد (للاكتمال واللحظية) في 1–5:

items.prompt: 1 When Ali saw the teacher ______ (come) along the corridor, he ran back into the classroom.
2 In the mornings, after prayer, I always watch the sun ______ (rise) above the mountains and then have breakfast.
3 One day last year I saw a plane ______ (crash) into the ground and even from a distance... I could hear the petrol ______ (explode).
4 Eye-witnesses felt the ground ______ (shake) beneath their feet...
4b ... and saw blocks of flats ______ (collapse) like packs of cards.
5 In the terrible famine in Africa you could see people ______ (die) of hunger...

hints: 1: رآه قادماً في الممر فهرع (استمرار coming). 2: شروق كامل ثم فطور (rise). 3: حدث لحظي كامل (crash/explode). 4: تصح الصيغتان (المصدر للاكتمال أو -ing لوصف مشهد الزلزال المستمر). 5: مشهد طويل ممتد (dying / crying).

questions.stem: Which modal verb expresses 'not allowed to do something' in PB page 36 (e.g., WB 5.5 A #6: public library)?

options.why_wrong: يؤكّد PB ص 36 أن must not (mustn't) حصراً تُستخدم للمنع (not allowed)، بينما تُستعمل can't للاستحالة أو انعدام المقدرة.
might not تفيد ضعف الاحتمال (perhaps not)، لا المنع.
must تفيد الإلزام أو اليقين الإيجابي.

hints: اقرأ الملاحظة (Note) داخل الصندوق الأصفر الثاني في PB ص 36.
questions.explain: تنص ملاحظة PB ص 36 على أن must not (mustn't) لا تُستخدم إلا لمنع شخص من فعل شيء غير مسموح به.

questions.stem: Why does WB 5.5 B #2 ('watch the sun ______ above the mountains and then have breakfast') take the bare infinitive 'rise'?

options.text: Because the action of watching the sunrise is viewed as completed before having breakfast.
Because sense verbs can never take -ing forms.
options.why_wrong: تقبل أفعال الحواس صيغة -ing لإبراز الاستمرار كما في المثال الأول coming أو الخامس dying.

options.text: Because 'and then' always requires -ed past tense.
options.why_wrong: الفعل watch جاء بعد always للمضارع، وما بعد المفعول يأخذ مصدراً مجرداً (rise) لا ماضياً.
أفعال الحواس تتبع بمصدر مجرد بدون to.

hints: راجع قاعدة 2 في PB ص 36: When followed by the infinitive, this emphasizes that the action is completed.
questions.explain: يشاهد المتحدث شروق الشمس كاملاً ثم يتناول إفطاره، ومن ثمَّ استُعمل المصدر المجرد rise لتأكيد اكتمال الفعل.

flashcards.back: can't = مستحيل / لا يقدر | must not (mustn't) = ممنوع / غير مسموح
V-ing = فعل مستمر ومشهد قيد الحدوث | V1 = فعل مكتمل من أوله لآخره
